questions.question: She speaks English very _____.
questions.explanation_cn: 修饰动词 speaks 要用副词 well，而不是形容词 good。
questions.explanation_en: Use the adverb 'well' to modify the verb 'speaks'.

questions.question: This book is _____ than the one I read last week.
questions.explanation_cn: than 表示比较，因此使用比较级 more interesting。
questions.explanation_en: The word 'than' requires the comparative form.

questions.question: Jack is the _____ student in our class.
questions.explanation_cn: the 后面表示三者及以上最高级，因此使用 tallest。
questions.explanation_en: Use the superlative form after 'the' when comparing three or more.

questions.question: The train arrived _____ than we expected.
questions.explanation_cn: than 表示比较，因此使用 earlier。
questions.explanation_en: 'Than' signals a comparison, so use the comparative adverb 'earlier'.

questions.question: This is one of the _____ cities in Australia.
questions.explanation_cn: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 是固定结构。
questions.explanation_en: 'One of the' is followed by a superlative adjective.

questions.question: He completed the task _____ than anyone else.
questions.explanation_cn: 修饰动词 completed 用副词；than 表示比较，因此用 more quickly。
questions.explanation_en: Use the comparative adverb 'more quickly' because of 'than'.

questions.question: This exam is _____ as the previous one.
questions.explanation_cn: as...as 表示双方程度相同，固定结构为 as + 形容词原级 + as。
questions.explanation_en: Use 'as + adjective + as' to show equal comparison.

questions.question: Tom worked _____ all the other employees.
questions.explanation_cn: 与其他所有员工比较，应使用比较级 harder than。hardly 意为'几乎不'，意思完全不同。
questions.explanation_en: 'Harder than' is the correct comparative form. 'Hardly' means 'almost not' and is unrelated.

questions.question: The weather today is not _____ yesterday.
questions.explanation_cn: 否定比较使用 not as...as，不能使用 so colder than。

questions.question: The _____ you practise, the _____ you become.
questions.explanation_cn: 固定句型：The + 比较级，the + 比较级，表示'越……，越……'。
questions.explanation_en: Use the pattern 'The + comparative..., the + comparative...' to express increasing change.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences are grammatically correct?

options.text: She sings better than her sister.
This is the most expensive restaurant in town.
Tom is more taller than Jack.
The harder you study, the more confident you become.

questions.explanation_cn: A 正确：副词比较级。B 正确：最高级结构。C 错误：不能同时使用 more 和 taller。D 正确：'The + 比较级，the + 比较级' 为固定句型。
questions.explanation_en: A uses the comparative adverb correctly. B uses the superlative correctly. C is incorrect because 'more taller' is redundant. D correctly follows the double-comparative pattern.
